name: Israel, Gaza & region
summary: Israel strikes south Lebanon towns on 4 Nov; US–Iran war fronts stay active
state: Israeli forces struck towns and burned homes in southern Lebanon on 4 Nov, and Lebanon said an Israeli strike killed one person, the most intense activity there in weeks (Anadolu-owned A News; Arab News). The US–Iran war continues, with tankers hit in Hormuz on 5 Nov and Tehran contacting Gulf states amid fears of US strikes (Al Jazeera). Several fronts are active at once.
for_you: Follow FCDO travel advice for Israel, Lebanon and the Gulf, which can change at short notice.
